title: I made a free French politics sim where you run a party, win seats and try to survive the National Assembly
author: Hemicyle2027
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I've been building Hémicycle, a browser strategy game about French politics. You lead a party, campaign across 577 constituencies, build alliances, win the legislative and presidential elections, then try to govern without being brought down by a no-confidence vote.

What's in it right now:

* A full presidential race: endorsements, costed manifesto, rally tour, daily polls and live TV debates
* Legislative elections on a real map of France, with second-round withdrawals and alliance deals
* Governing: 58 bills, the Senate and the shuttle, 49.3, ordinances, dissolution, cohabitation, crises
* Unions, employers and social movements that react to your policies
* A fake social network that reacts to everything, journalists who investigate you, and gaffes that come back to haunt you in debates
* Career mode: start as a young activist and climb to the Élysée, solo or against a friend in the same party
* Historical scenarios from 1981 to 2024, plus a 2027 presidential mode
* A 5-minute guided first game for newcomers
* Online multiplayer, a leaderboard and career trophies

It's free, runs in your browser and works on phone and desktop. It's available in English and French.

Play here: [https://hemicyle2027.neocities.org/](https://hemicyle2027.neocities.org/)

Discord (feedback, bug reports, update news): [https://discord.gg/2Bsjm5dB4H](https://discord.gg/2Bsjm5dB4H)

It's a solo project, so any feedback helps. Tell me which party you played and how long your government lasted :)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Hemicyle2027 please add some details about how you used AI to develop this. Saying you used AI isn't enough on its own. We're looking for the actual dev details. Rule 4 asks promotional posts to contribute by talking about the process and the actual development. We're trying to keep the sub from filling up with low quality game posts. If this doesn't get updated, it may be removed.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Please see the requirements for posts about commercial games promotion.

**Game Promotion Posts Allowed, with Requirements**

You must discuss your game within the context of how it was developed using AI. Share with the community and give something for the community to talk about in your development experience with AI. A fire and forget video/image with no text, chatGPT bullet list may be removed by mods. If your game is being sold, you MUST apply the "Commercial Self Promotion" flair.
